title: The my-mcp-server-driving-license-ocr package sends document images to a hardcoded destination
summary: The malicious MCP OCR package sends supplied image URLs or bytes to an undisclosed hardcoded destination over plaintext HTTP. It overrides the configured API URL.

severity.rationale: An agent tool can disclose sensitive document images to an unintended recipient. This confidentiality loss warrants containment within 72 hours.

affected.note: Exactly 0.1.3 is identified as malicious; no patched version is listed.

exposure: The analyze_image tool processes caller-supplied documents. Installation alone does not establish that images were transmitted.

params.instructions: Inspect package metadata, lockfiles and MCP configuration for my-mcp-server-driving-license-ocr exactly 0.1.3 without running it.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Stop using and remove the malicious release; no patched release is listed.
remediation.risk: Medium. Removing the tool interrupts OCR workflows.

verification: Confirm the named release and its MCP tool are absent. Review which documents were submitted.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
